name: front-end-checklist
description: Review frontend code and live pages against 386 quality-gated rules for accessibility, performance, SEO, security, and HTML/CSS/JS best practices.

interface.longDescription: Review frontend source and public HTTPS pages using quality-gated Front-End Checklist guidance for accessibility, performance, SEO, security, and modern web development. Static checks return supported findings and rule references; they do not execute JavaScript, measure Web Vitals, or certify WCAG compliance. MCP tools are read-only; your agent can apply suggested changes with your permission.
defaultPrompt: Review this component with the Front-End Checklist
Audit https://example.com for accessibility and SEO issues
Run the launch checklist before we ship

positive.prompt: Review this HTML with Front-End Checklist: <form><input type="email" id="email"><button type="submit">Subscribe</button></form>
positive.expected_behavior: Identify the missing accessible label and return actionable rule guidance; do not claim a complete accessibility audit.

positive.prompt: Use Front-End Checklist to explain the alt-text rule and how to verify it.
positive.expected_behavior: Return the alt-text rule, verification guidance, sources and decorative-image caveats.

positive.prompt: Search Front-End Checklist for Largest Contentful Paint guidance.
positive.expected_behavior: Return relevant rules and their slugs; do not invent measured performance results.

positive.prompt: Get the Front-End Checklist workflow for a pre-launch audit.
positive.expected_behavior: Return an available ordered launch workflow; use available slugs, do not invent one.
Fetch the public page and return static HTML findings or a clear fetch error; do not claim browser execution.

negative.prompt: Use Front-End Checklist to audit https://127.0.0.1/admin.
negative.expected_behavior: Refuse private-network fetching or return the tool safety error; offer review_code with user-provided sanitized source.

negative.prompt: Use Front-End Checklist to show another user's private checklist progress.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain that no account-data tool exists; do not invent data or attempt access.

negative.prompt: Use Front-End Checklist to certify that this snippet is fully WCAG compliant: <button>Save</button>.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the limits of static checks and suggest browser, keyboard and assistive-technology verification; do not certify compliance.

review.commerce_description: The MCP plugin does not sell products or process payments.

publication.release_notes: Initial plugin package with the hosted Front-End Checklist MCP, one global audit skill, and reviewer test cases.
